title: FAA Pauses Router Installations After Nationwide Ground Stop
summary: The agency approved a daytime upgrade to the network and a contractor’s step-by-step installation plan.

title: One Airline’s Frantic Race to Avoid a Ground-Stop Meltdown
summary: From its operations center in Dallas, Southwest halted bag checking and parked aircraft, then moved around planes and crews to get flights back to normal.

title: Bankrupt Dish Wireless Strikes $525 Million Settlement Deal With American Tower
summary: The EchoStar subsidiary said it is in talks to settle with other tower owners, but Crown Castle, which has the largest claim, says it hasn’t been contacted.
